policies.title: Returns
policies.text: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if unused. Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days.

policies.title: Shipping
policies.text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 7 business days. Orders ship within 2 business days of being placed.

policies.title: Damaged items
policies.text: If an item arrives damaged, contact support within 7 days with a photo and we will send a free replacement.

policies.title: Cancellations
policies.text: Orders can be cancelled free of charge while their status is processing. Shipped orders must be returned instead.
